Ultimate ASI Loader
===================

This directory contains an unmodified Win32 Ultimate ASI Loader v9.7.4 binary
by ThirteenAG. The upstream dinput8.dll was renamed to dinput.dll because the
supported Prey executable imports the legacy DINPUT library.

Upstream project:
https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader

Pinned release:
https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader/releases/tag/v9.7.4

Source archive:
Ultimate-ASI-Loader-NoPDB.zip

Source archive SHA-256:
14B3A1AD018899571AC9AA01482977F3C6D49E6CBA99F552D01C5ACACD1315E1

dinput.dll SHA-256:
EC2F4824ECA58DD40F425756A4A7CEC77B8E381F21D11D7C846EC4B339B617AB

Original filename recorded by the binary:
Ultimate-ASI-Loader-Win32.dll

The loader is third-party software distributed under its included MIT license.
It is not part of PreyHFR and may also be used by other installed ASI plugins.
